Feast of the Holy Innocents (Childermas Banquet)

A Whimsical Childermas Banquet at Home

Join us for a heartwarming Feast of the Holy Innocents, a day dedicated to celebrating the youngest members of our family with special traditions and a delightful banquet.

  1. Morning

    Setting the Whimsical Table

    Begin the day by decorating your table with white candles, holly berries, and silver bells, creating a magical atmosphere. You can also start preparing dough for rolls or components for the bisque and gratin.

    Recipes: Pillowy Milk Rolls · Baby Beet Bisque · Baby Corn Gratin · Braised Baby Onions

  2. Late Morning

    Culinary Preparations

    Continue with the main cooking, ensuring dishes are prepared with the spirit of child-sized servings in mind. This is a good time for longer-cooking items like ribs and hens.

    Recipes: Slow-Smoked Baby Back Ribs · Herb-Roasted Cornish Hens · Duck-Fat Roasted Baby Potatoes

  3. Early Afternoon

    Choosing Our Presider

    Gather the family and invite the youngest member to take on the special role of the day's presider, who will announce each course of our banquet.

  4. Late Afternoon

    Festive Aperitifs

    As the family gathers, serve a special, sparkling aperitif to kick off the celebration, setting a joyful and celebratory tone for the evening.

    Recipes: Baby Bellini Aperitif

  5. Evening - First Course

    A Warm Welcome

    Our youngest presider proudly announces the first course: a comforting and beautifully swirled baby beet bisque, served with star-cut rye croutons.

    Recipes: Baby Beet Bisque

  6. Evening - Main Feast

    The Grand Banquet

    The presider introduces the array of main dishes, from lacquered ribs and roasted hens to delightful baby sides, all served in charming, child-friendly portions.

    Recipes: Simple Baby Greens Salad with Vinaigrette · Slow-Smoked Baby Back Ribs · Herb-Roasted Cornish Hens · Duck-Fat Roasted Baby Potatoes · Baby Corn Gratin · Braised Baby Onions · Pillowy Milk Rolls · Whipped Honey Butter

  7. Evening - Sweet Endings

    Dessert Delights

    Our presider presents the sweet conclusion to our feast, offering a choice of individual cheesecakes or a tableside flambéed treat.

    Recipes: Baby Cheesecakes · Tableside Baby Bananas Foster

  8. Late Evening

    A Heartfelt Toast

    Conclude this special day with a warm toast, raising a glass of Babycham or a comforting milk punch to the innocence and joy of the season.

    Recipes: Babycham Childermas Sparkle · Warm Milk Punch

May your Childermas be filled with warmth, laughter, and the precious joy of your family's youngest members.
